name: Shinar
line: Shinar is the plain between the rivers, later called Babylonia, where people began to build the tower city of Babel and where Nimrod's kingdom began.

moments.title: Nimrod's kingdom begins
moments.text: Nimrod's kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar. From there he went on into Assyria and built Nineveh and other cities.

moments.title: The tower of Babel
moments.text: People settled on a plain in Shinar and began to build a city and a tower to make a name for themselves. The LORD confused their language and scattered them over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

moments.title: Temple items carried to Shinar
moments.text: The Lord let Nebuchadnezzar take King Jehoiakim and some objects from God's house. Nebuchadnezzar carried the objects to the land of Shinar and put them in the treasury of his god.
